items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: [DAN MORGENSTERN] Well, this is September 27, 1984, I'm Dan Morgenstern, and we are talking to Jimmy Rowles.

ctx.x: I was born in Spokane, Washington, 1918, August 19th. And the story goes from there. How does that sound?
Well, this is September 27, 1984, I'm Dan Morgenstern, and we are talking to Jimmy Rowles. [ETC.]
So we said the story goes from there. Spokane is where Bing Crosby was born, right?
